data: PaySim synthetic mobile-money dataset (Kaggle: ealaxi/paysim1), feasible TRANSFER rows only
citation: Lopez-Rojas, Elmir, Axelsson (2016). PaySim: A financial mobile money simulator for fraud detection. EMSS.

feature_definitions.share: amount / sender balance before the transfer
feature_definitions.drained: 1 if the amount equals the sender's whole balance, else 0
feature_definitions.dest_new: 1 if the receiving wallet has received no earlier transaction, else 0
feature_definitions.log_dest_prior: natural log of (1 + number of earlier transactions received by the receiving wallet)

warning: Trained on synthetic data. Scores are illustrative, not calibrated for real customers.
